Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_RemoteReadOnl: When enabled players can open the Economy Center anywhere via hotkey or floating button, but only to browse (catalog, wallet, receipts); every trade, listing and claim still requires standing next to a registered terminal. When disabled the window only opens at a terminal.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_CheckinAmount: Fixed amount each account can claim once per server reward day. Reward days follow the server real-world clock, not the in-game date.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_CheckinMinPla: Minutes connected to the server today before the check-in can be claimed. Measured with the server real-world clock, independent of the in-game time multiplier. 0 allows claiming right after login.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_CheckinServer: Total check-in amount the whole server can pay out per reward day. 0 means unlimited (default): one fixed amount per account per day is already bounded by the player count. When the cap is reached the claim is refused without being consumed and is not paid retroactively.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_RewardDayRese: Daily check-in and daily caps reset at this UTC hour. Taiwan 04:00 equals UTC 20 (default).
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_AdminAdjustMa: Largest single balance adjustment an admin can make in the admin panel (per currency). Bigger corrections must be split or go through the case repair flow. This protects against compromised admin accounts, so it can only be changed here, not in the panel.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_AdminAdjustDa: Per admin per reward day: separate totals for credits and debits (they do not offset each other).
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_AdminAdjustSe: All admins combined per reward day: separate totals for credits and debits.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_AdminReasonMi: Minimum number of characters of the mandatory reason when adjusting a balance; the reason is written to the audit log and the external ledger.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_AdminRoles_to: Server role names that may adjust balances, change currency settings and register terminals; separate several with semicolons (e.g. admin;gm). The server re-checks the role name on every admin command; the client display is not authorization.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_ReadOnlyRoles: Server role names that may view player balances, receipts, audit and dashboard but cannot act; separate several with semicolons.
